Discriminant -6888 and W(11/2)=-6, W(6)=3 establish the unique contact algebraic root. B=0 branch has radius sqrt(3/(2pi)); f(0)<0 is excluded by strictly improving a positive Gaussian shift. Symbolic checker reproduces the critical certificate; limits disclosed.

value.rationale: The exact first three Fourier +1 Hermite modes supply a motivated finite cutoff for the canonical Bourgain–Clozel–Kahane sign-uncertainty problem. Its sharp algebraic radius and all equality cases reveal the simple boundary root plus tangential outer double root geometry and furnish an exact finite-packet benchmark missing from asymptotic and numerical results; no paper-scale global breakthrough or stronger bound on the unrestricted optimum is alleged.
